query: Write a script that supplies 100 USDC to XOXNO lending for my wallet G... on Stellar mainnet using the SDK.
expected_behavior: Imports from '@xoxno/sdk-js/stellar-lending' (the published subpath), not '@xoxno/sdk-js/stellar' or a deep dist path
Use spokeId >= 1. A zero or omitted accountNonce opens an account. Select existing accountId from the v1 positions array for a top-up.
Sets sourceSequence from rpc.Server.getAccount(caller) and never confuses the Stellar sequence with the lending accountNonce
Resolves controllerAddress and hub/asset from getStellarDeployment / configs (linking addresses.md) instead of hardcoding a C... address in code
Use parseStellarTokenAmount for decimal input. Pass the resulting base-unit i128 string to the synchronous supply builder.
Follows getAccount -> buildStellarSupplyTx -> prepareStellarBuiltTx -> sign -> sendTransaction -> poll getTransaction, and treats PENDING/DUPLICATE as 'not yet confirmed' rather than failure
machine_checkable: Generated TypeScript passes tsc --noEmit against @xoxno/sdk-js@1.0.228 and @stellar/stellar-sdk@^16
Source contains 'stellar-lending' import and no 'spokeId: 0' literal
